title: blob-server: Blob/lookup handler
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B9. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: S.

Implement handle_blob_lookup in lookup.rs per docs/design/blobext.md §5 'Blob/lookup' (blobext-03 §6): typeNames and ids required; enforce_max_objects_in_get; each type must be in supportedTypeNames, have a capability from lookup_type_capability (registry default, B1/decision 14) and that capability must be in cx.using, else method-level unknownDataType naming the type; one blob_references call per type; list in request order, every requested type a key defaulting to []; no notFound. Common start incl. BlobMode Conflict -> invalidArguments. Acceptance: tests/lookup.rs with -03 §9.3 verbatim; unknownDataType for an unadvertised name, for mail not in using, and for Identity; hidden object omitted; unknown blob -> empty arrays.
